author.registered.subject: Your author account is ready
author.registered.message: Your author account was created. This message does not verify your identity or approve a manuscript.

contact.received.subject: We received your message
contact.received.message: Your message was recorded for the publishing team. Keep this reference for follow-up.

manuscript.received.subject: Your manuscript was received
manuscript.received.message: Your manuscript was recorded for editorial review. Receipt does not mean acceptance for publication.

intake.contact.subject: A publishing inquiry needs review
intake.contact.message: A new publishing inquiry is stored in the author-intake records. Review it in the protected operating records.

intake.manuscript.subject: A manuscript is ready for review
intake.manuscript.message: A new manuscript is stored for editorial review. No manuscript content is included in this email.

account.reset_help.subject: An author requested account help
account.reset_help.message: An account-help request is stored for support review. Follow the existing identity-verification process before changing access.
